summary: CI runner proxy JWT TTL skew during vault rewrap evicting canary artifact cache
description:
Issue summary: During an automated KMS/Vault rewrap of the proxy service token, CI runners started failing authentication to the internal HTTP proxy. This led to repeated runner reconnects and eviction of local artifact caches during a canary release window. Impact: several canary jobs were retried and lost cached artifacts, increasing runtime by ~10x and causing a canary rollback.

Impact: - 12 canary release jobs failed or were retried between 02:10–02:47 UTC. - Increased load on artifact store and degraded release pipeline throughput. - Customers on the canary window experienced delayed deployments (release rollback triggered).

Environment: production (us-east) runners behind internal proxy (runner-proxy-v2), vault transit rewrap job ran at 02:05 UTC.
steps_to_reproduce: Schedule a Vault transit key rewrap that rotates the proxy service token (simulate with staging cert).
Trigger a canary release with CI runners pinned to the proxy pool in us-east and with artifact cache enabled.
Observe runner logs for repeated 401/403 from proxy followed by runner reconnect and cache eviction messages.
Observe canary jobs being retried and artifact pull rates spiking on the artifact store.
observed_behavior: Runners received 401/403 for proxy requests starting ~02:10 UTC after rewrap completed.
Runner process performed TLS/connection re-establishment and then logged 'artifact cache invalidated: auth-mismatch'.
Canary orchestrator marked multiple jobs as unstable and initiated rollback at ~02:50 UTC.
expected_behavior: Proxy token rotation should be transparent to active runners (grace period or token exchange).
Runner artifact cache should survive token refresh or have a graceful handoff path.
logs: [runner-14321] 2026-03-02T02:12:09Z WARN cache: eviction triggered due to auth validation failure
[proxy-v2] 2026-03-02T02:05:02Z INFO rewrap: transit rewrap completed, new_token_id=tok-7b1f
[proxy-v2] 2026-03-02T02:05:05Z INFO token-publish: broadcast token epoch=97 ttl=300s
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: token TTL published by Vault rewrap (300s) was shorter than runner re-auth window, causing mismatch.
Checked proxy token cache — observed a race where proxy accepted old token for ~10s, then started rejecting until runners picked up a new exchange endpoint.
Runner code expects token refresh via STS endpoint but proxy rewrap changed token id; no fallback to exchange endpoint was attempted by older runner version (v1.14.2).
Artifact cache is bound to a proxy-auth context; eviction is triggered when auth_digest changes.
root_cause: Race between Vault transit rewrap publishing a token id change and older runner versions (v1.14.2) lacking the automatic exchange fallback. The proxy enforces token id binding for artifact cache; when tokens changed mid-session, cache was invalidated.
mitigation_steps: 1) Reverted to previous token epoch within 8 minutes to restore connectivity for outstanding runners.
2) Temporarily paused further vault rewrap jobs and scheduled a coordinated token-rotation rollout with a rolling grace window for runners.
3) Rolled forward runner fleet to v1.15.0 on a subset (canary) which contains exchange fallback logic.
4) Increased token grace TTL during rotation from 300s -> 600s for next scheduled rewrap to avoid immediate eviction.
comments: Marisol Vega (reporter) 2026-03-02: Observed spike in artifact store egress and canary rollback triggered automatically by orchestrator. Raising urgency due to potential customer impact.
Evan Patel (assignee) 2026-03-02: Reverted token epoch and paused rotations. Gathering runner logs for versions; initial look points at v1.14.x fleet.
SRE on-call (Priya Kumar) 2026-03-03: Confirmed proxy accepted old token for ~12s then invalidated; added temporary metric for proxy-token-age and token-id-delta.
Release Eng (Luis Ortega) 2026-03-04: Will queue a controlled canary run once runner fleet patched and token grace TTL increased. Need postmortem to adjust rotation playbook.
Evan Patel 2026-03-05: Pushed v1.15.0 to 60% of runners in us-east; monitoring artifact hit-rate and authentication error rate.
resolution_notes: Deployed runner v1.15.0 which implements token-exchange fallback; verified canary jobs completed without cache eviction on 2026-03-05 08:12 UTC.
Updated Vault rotation playbook to include: pre-notify runner fleet, set temporary grace TTL, and stagger rotations by region.
Added a proxy metric and alert for token-id churn and token-reject-rate > 1% per minute.
Follow-up action: author a runbook change and schedule retro with Release and Security teams (owner: Luis Ortega, due 2026-03-12).
followup_actions: Create runbook PR to Confluence: 'Token Rotation for Runner Proxy' (owner: Luis Ortega).
Backfill canary tests to include token-rotation simulation as part of pre-merge suite (owner: QA team).
Plan a coordinated multi-region rotation drill 2026-03-18.
